newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar steady by close, spreads feature.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar steady by close, spreads feature.

text.p: White sugar futures held steady in late trading on Thursday with the March/May spread continuing to feature as traders rolled spot positions forward before next week's March expiry.

At 1830 GMT March was up $1.00 at $304.40 after hitting a high of $305.50. May was up 60 cents at $301.90. Crossed trades by trade and commission house players on the March/May spread boosted the overall turnover of 4,871 lots in another heavy session and also widened the spread, traders said.
On Wednesday market volume reached an all-time record high of 7,989 lots, surpassing the previous record of 7,215 lots set in April 1995.
On the physical front traders said Iran was likely to have rejected bids in its recent tender to buy 14,000 tonnes of white sugar for April delivery.
